music.prompt: Light, relaxed instrumental background music for a short, friendly software demo. Soft Rhodes electric piano, gentle brushed drums, warm round bass, a little acoustic guitar. Around 90 BPM, cheerful and calm, unobtrusive, sits quietly under a voice-over. Steady groove throughout with no big build-ups or drops. Ends gently on a soft resolved chord that rings out over the last two seconds.
